feasibility.rationale: Direct paper evidence reports 10 h and 5 h for the two full fine-tuning stages on one H100, and 13 RTX-5090 GPU-minutes for 4,451 predictions. Scaling only inference to 1,491 target rows, adding 0.75 h download, 1 h environment/setup and 0.25 h evaluation/serialization, then applying a 20% reserve gives 20.49 h / 73,754 s. The reported single-H100 execution proves compatibility with 80 GB GPU memory. ZIP central-directory metadata and repository sizes bound scientific inputs below 4 GB expanded; 20 GB conservatively includes environment, caches, checkpoints and logs.
